extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: full-size (4/4) violin, 59 cm long, body 35.6 cm, lower bout 20.8 cm, with 75 cm bow
extras.notes: violin lies on its back, slightly tilted so that back and scroll rest on the ground; arched top and back, purfling, f-holes as dark inlays, spruce-coloured bridge, ebony fingerboard, pegs (G/D left, A/E right), tailpiece with E fine tuner, chinrest on the bass side, 4 strings; the bow is the separate object violin_bow lying on its side in front; no text, no logo

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
